# Frozen v1 Output

Captured on 2026-10-28 before M3.2 edits by printing the existing
`persistence.build_text(values, ConfigSections(...))` result and its UTF-8 SHA256
with `.venv/bin/python -c`. Transcribed as literal files using apply_patch, not
generated by tests or by the new codec. Both files include a final LF.

| File | SHA256 |
| --- | --- |
| combined.lua | b9cf20426011f4af74e77ff041a9bbba16cee93046f9924aface55e277fc1bba |
| empty.lua | bc75ca71ad89fac9c87dc2c05e4c178638bdc66c8699d694a61ae8d0ea66e4f5 |

The combined capture uses scalars `general:gaps_in=7`, `decoration:rounding=12`,
`animations:enabled=true`; Bezier `ease, 0.1, 0.2, 0.8, 1`; animation
`windows, 1, 5, ease`; and monitors `DP-1, 2560x1440@144, 0x0, 1`,
`HDMI-A-9, disable`, `DP-9, preferred, auto, 1`, in that order. The last two
exercise disabled/disconnected preservation without querying hardware.
All other ConfigSections fields retain their existing None defaults.
The empty capture is `build_text({}, ConfigSections())`, not an unowned empty file.

These are historical full bundles, never scoped appearance/display documents.
Do not refresh them to accommodate renderer changes; investigate compatibility
failures instead. Full byte hashes are distinct from v2 scope-local content IDs.
